svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 20 x 16 mm piece of 2.5 mm aluminium plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 3.2 mm holes, 2 mm from the short edges, 3 mm up from the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glue or screw the Hall sensor to its face, centred 11 mm up,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sensing face outward, 3 mm proud of the bracket.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the left rail's inside wall, centred under the front axle,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom 13 mm above the rail's underside, with two M3 screws into

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rivet nuts. The sensor then faces the magnet ring on the roller end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 18 mm below the axle, with a 1.5 mm air gap.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: turn the roller by hand; the sensor light (or a meter)
